name: ai-test
description: 测试领域的 Claude Code —— API / Web / Android 可编程测试平台

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/ir packages/engine packages/adapter-http packages/adapter-web packages/store packages/cli packages/web packages/server
scripts.clean: tsc -b --clean packages/ir packages/engine packages/adapter-http packages/adapter-web packages/store packages/cli packages/web packages/server
scripts.lint: tsc -b packages/ir packages/engine packages/adapter-http packages/adapter-web packages/store packages/cli packages/web packages/server && node tooling/lint-layers.mjs && node tooling/unread-fields.mjs && node tooling/dead-iface-fields.mjs && node tooling/ref-lint.mjs
scripts.typecheck:test: tsc -p packages/ir/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/engine/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/adapter-http/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/adapter-web/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/store/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/web/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/server/tsconfig.test.json
scripts.pretest: tsc -b packages/ir packages/engine packages/adapter-http packages/adapter-web packages/store packages/cli packages/web packages/server
